caption:
Microsoft's new 'humanist AI' policy means their tools won't execute tasks that might violate rules. For example, if you ask it to draft an email that could be seen as unprofessional, it will fail instead of sending it. 

This affects tools like Copilot for Business. If you try to send client communications through AI, you'll need to manually approve them first. It's a safety move but it means you can't rely on AI to handle client outreach alone anymore. 

Save this prompt to make your AI tools obey your rules:

"Write a professional email to [Client Name] about [Topic]. Avoid any phrases that could be seen as unprofessional or risky. If unsure, fail instead of sending."
